name: manual_f0a26d
claim: The control-plane auth scheme has two independent lanes plus an outbound-only override: PT lane (PT_CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN env + Perpetua-Tools/.state/control_plane_token file), orama lane (ORAMA_CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN / ORAMA_CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN_LOCAL env), and ORAMA_CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN_PEER (tried first on outbound probes only). auth_mode reports unset/pt_only/orama_only/joint depending on which lanes have candidates; joint means either lane's token unlocks both services.

decisions.notes: Spent a long debugging arc assuming a single shared secret model before realizing probe_lan_peer.py's auth_mode field (in src/utils/control_plane_auth.py) already encodes this precisely. Setting ORAMA_CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN directly (not just as PEER) was what actually fixed portal-status; PEER alone was enough for ws-peer but not portal-status, which needed the orama lane populated.
